newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshi men castrated by jealous wives.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi men castrated by jealous wives.

text.p: Two jealous Bangladeshi wives castrated their husbands for having affairs with other women, police said on Tuesday.

"He would not listen to me... he had sex regularly with a woman he says is his second wife. But the law says he needs my permission for a second marriage," Renu Begum, wife of factory worker Manzurul Alam, told police.
Police said she castrated Alam while he was asleep on Sunday night.
The other victim, taxi driver Nur Mohammad, was castrated by his knife-wielding wife Ferdous Ara on Monday after he had been drinking, police said.
"He comes home drunk everyday and tortures me. He also goes to other women. So I decided to punish him," Ara told police.
Police have arrested both women, and say they may face up to two years in prison.
